rules: Real questions with the merchant's answers only; never an empty answer.
No two titled Faq sections on one page.
`align: two-columns` and `expand: all` are not used by the reference stores; check the preview before relying on them.
Keep `id` and `display_sequence` on pulled modules when they carry them.

Always write `appearance.expand`: the schema default opens the first answer. `none` is the default choice; `first` only when the first answer is 400 characters or less and the FAQ is the page's main content. On a product page all answers start closed.

A Faq title follows only `appearance.align` (centred at `center`, left otherwise), never the theme. Presets marked `title_follows_theme` are fitted by `presets apply --work`: under a centred theme a titled Faq gets `align: center`; the lint reports any mismatch as `title-align-mixed`.

Questions run at `columns` 8 or narrower in the theme's box: at 12 a line is about 1300 px. Every preset writes `section.isFullscreen: "disabled"`: under a theme that spans sections across the screen, 8 columns run about 1240 px on a 1920 px window (`text-measure`).

presets.name: faq-main-end
presets.use: 3-6 buyer questions near the end of home or on the product page.
presets.evidence: of 9 stores running a Faq: with-dividers in 6, plus-and-minus in 7; answers start closed in about as many stores as open the first one, and closed is kept for phones

presets.name: pdp-care-faq
presets.use: Care, warranty, returns or usage questions right under ProductDetails or after the first shelf: all closed, so phones show only the questions.
presets.evidence: a Faq on 3 default product pages; an open first answer of about 2,000 characters took two phone screens
fill: `modules`: 3-6 questions from the merchant, answers of 400 characters or less.

presets.name: faq-service-left
presets.use: Service and legal pages: a titled Faq at the width and the left edge of the page's text (`service-page-text`), whatever the theme's alignment.
presets.evidence: not counted: built from the measure and alignment of service pages (principles 1 and 25), not from a store's look
presets.basis: principles 1 and 25: a service page reads left-aligned at one text width

presets.name: faq-centered-narrow
presets.use: Centred narrow column for brand-led pages: what `faq-main-end` becomes under a centred theme, with more air.

presets.name: faq-topic-chain
presets.use: Help page: untitled Faq under a RichText `topic-label`, one per topic, left at the width of the topic label. Give the last one `paddingBottom: double`.

presets.name: faq-island
presets.use: One rounded card; suits rounded themes (normal, soft).

presets.name: faq-island-background
presets.use: Card on a filled background: B2B and wholesale landings.
presets.evidence: 1 store, plus the B2B landing recipe

presets.name: info-accordion
presets.use: Untitled service rows under the last grid: payment, returns, care, custom orders; in the theme's box, so an answer keeps a reading width.
